dimensions.assessment: Affects all federal programs funded via annual appropriations that lack active statutory authorization of appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: reoccurring three-year budgetary level reduction cycle with respect to any unauthorized program

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory funding cuts of 10 to 15 percent and terminates unauthorized federal programs entirely after three years.
dimensions.evidence: effective immediately on October 1 of the fiscal year immediately following such third fiscal year, be terminated

dimensions.assessment: Reduces budgetary spending allocations (302(a) allocations) by percentages of funds previously appropriated for unauthorized programs.
dimensions.evidence: reduced by an amount equal to 10 percent of the funds appropriated for such program in the expiring fiscal year

dimensions.assessment: Amends the congressional budget and appropriations process by tying spending allocations to program authorization status.
dimensions.evidence: There is hereby established a reoccurring three-year budgetary level reduction cycle with respect to any unauthorized program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent, recurring statutory process for federal budget reductions and program terminations.
dimensions.evidence: reoccurring three-year budgetary level reduction cycle... to begin in fiscal year 2026

importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a mandatory three-year budgetary reduction schedule and ultimate program termination for federal programs lacking an active authorization of appropriations.
